### Revenue Growth  
Intel has experienced significant revenue decline, with year-over-year drops of -20.2% in 2022 and -14.0% in 2023, and a -9.6% CAGR over the period. Modest stabilization is projected, with near-flat growth in 2024 and 2025 before returning to positive mid-single-digit growth rates from 2025E onward.

### Gross Profit Margin  
Gross profit margin (contribution margin) deteriorated sharply from 55.4% in 2021 to 40.0% in 2023, and is expected to bottom out at 32.7% in 2024 before gradually recovering to 37.8% by 2027. This margin pressure highlights increased cost challenges and competitive headwinds.

### SG&A Expense Margin  
SG&A as a percentage of revenue increased from 8.3% in 2021 to 11.1% in 2022 but is forecasted to decline steadily to 7.2% by 2027. This suggests Intel is actively managing operating expenses as part of its turnaround efforts.

### EBITDA Margin  
EBITDA margin has dropped precipitously from 42.9% in 2021 to just 2.3% in 2024, reflecting severe profitability pressures. However, margins are expected to recover meaningfully, reaching 30.6% by 2027, though they remain below historical highs and lag key peers like Nvidia.
